mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggers.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5% for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% within a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% in a 3-month window but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both increase by more than 1.5% in a month but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of supply chain disruption (indicated by a decline in industrial production below 105.0), manufacturing output contraction reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 105.0 and S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 255.0, it signals elevated inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain accommodative monetary policy, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 255.0 but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS shows a positive month-over-month change for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer confidence and labor market health, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases in the same month but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0, indicating manufacturing slowdown, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 110.0 but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.
